description:
Amazon WorkSpaces plays nice with everyone. Access your personal Windows environment on Android, iOS, Fire, Mac, PC, Chromebook, and Linux devices.


- [Windows] Improved full screen mode in the new client experience, adding a dedicated full screen button in the toolbar and a convenient dropdown to choose between full screen modes anytime.
- [Windows] Added language support for French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese in the new client experience (available under Settings).
- [Windows] Added an option to "Show in folder" to file upload notifications in the new client experience, simplifying the navigation to the uploaded file's location.
- [Windows] Re-enabled support for honoring printer preferences when printing from a session, which had been temporarily disabled in version 5.34.1.
- [Windows] Improved the message shown when choosing Try New WorkSpaces to clarify that PCoIP-based WorkSpaces and WorkSpaces Pools are not supported in the new client experience.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that allowed connecting to a WorkSpace that was not available, such as one under maintenance, under certain conditions.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that prevented signing in after the sign-in page had been open for about 30 minutes.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue that prevented the Settings and self-service options in the new client experience from displaying correctly when a high contrast theme was enabled or changed in the local Windows device.
- [Windows] Reduced the size of the client installer.
- [Windows] Updated the DCV SDK.
- [Windows] Updated the WebView2 SDK.
- [Windows] Additional bug fixes and enhancements.
